title: The usage line drops the model name before cutting the numbers
body:
The card's usage line (`usage` in `frame.rs`) reads `model · N% ctx · N tok · $N` and is cut to the card's width, so at the default font the tokens and cost are cut off first. Jack wants the numbers kept.

## Proposal

`usage` takes the room it has. When the whole line does not fit and a model is set, it leaves the model out, and only then cuts what is left.
